lines.text: I am sorry, Glyde. I don't have any choice.
What are you babbling about now? Wait! You're not-
We won't forget you! Glyde, good luck!
What do you think you are doing?
I'll get you for this, Teisel!
Okay, that takes care of Mr. Glyde.
Now, we have to fall back and regroup. Full steam ahead, Bon!
